meta.source: Supplied Fleury family charts and expanded archive reconstruction
meta.notes: This reconstruction is based on the supplied illustrated family-tree chart. Items explicitly marked 'Needs verification', unnamed spouses/children, and partially recovered names are preserved as uncertain rather than silently corrected. The chart itself states that its older French pedigree comes from photographs and that names/dates marked Needs verification require confirmation from original records.
meta.note: Names and relationships added from the supplied source photographs. Uncertain readings are marked Needs verification; ambiguous duplicate generations are kept as separate records rather than silently merged.
